'''Nichos Panib''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], he attended [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia's]] pilot briefing before heading to his fighter and flying as [[Green Four/Legends|Green Four]] during the battle. A noble from [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]], Panib painted his helmet to match that of [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]], an old friend of his mother's family.

==Behind the scenes==
Panib was first identified in "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch]]" in [[Star Wars Insider 146|''Star Wars Insider'' 146]]. His helmet is visible in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']].

Rece's helmet prop was originally used by [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], and later by an unknown pilot in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Costumes">''[[Star Wars Costumes: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref> The prop was seen again in the video game [[Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire|''Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire'']], worn by [[Ina Rece]].<ref name="RAII video">{{LucasArts|url=products/rebel2/reb_vid.htm|text=''Rebel Assault II'' - Live Action Video}}</ref>
